text:
violet: Quick sync — putting a draft of launch constraints + rollback criteria for Adaptive Capacity Controls on your radar. This is driven by customer A + our cost/SLO targets. (root: 1957654321)

aj: got it. can you paste the high-level acceptance criteria?

violet: sure — high-level acceptance / launch gates:
- functional: feature flags toggle, canary route works, metrics emitted for latency/cost/errors
- perf: p95 <= 120ms for 512 tokens on Dedicated pools under normal load
- cost: expected unit cost delta <= 15% vs current baseline for our sample workload
- reliability: <1% increase in user-facing errors during steady state
- security: threat-model signoff and KMS integration verified
- rollback: automatic fallback to small-model-variant + manual rollback playbook in SRE runbook

violet: rollout plan (draft):
```
routes:
  canary: 5%
  ramp: 25%
  prod: 100%
fallback: route: small-model-variant
monitoring: latency,cost,errors,cache-hit
criteria: step -> wait 30m stable -> proceed
```

sam: infra asks: we need a migration window for cache schema and a capacity reservation for the dedicated pool. also need ephemeral KV storage sized for peak QPS during canary. propose migration window Fri 12:00-16:00 UTC (to cover APAC overlap).

karen: security notes: must complete threat-model checklist and update audit retention to 1y for this feature. keys for any customer-specific config must be in KMS/HSM. pen-test signoff required before 25% ramp.

ben: oncall concerns: define automatic rollback thresholds. proposal: rollback if error rate > 3% for 5m OR p95 > 250ms for 10m. also require an immediate incident channel and runbook owner. who will own the runbook?

maria: I can own the runbook and the customer communication bundle (what we tell impacted customers). I'll also prepare the release notes and postmortem template.

aj: runtime notes: changing model variants requires KV cache invalidation strategy. prefer blue/green for runtime cache to avoid cold starts impacting p95. also suggest shipping quantized small-model as the fallback to keep cost down. I'll produce a compatibility matrix for model variants + memory footprint.

violet: action items (summary):
- @aj: runtime compatibility matrix + cache invalidation plan by Thu EOD
- @sam: confirm reserved capacity + migration window details by Wed
- @karen: schedule threat-model review and list open security blockers by Wed
- @ben: draft rollback playbook + alert thresholds by Thu
- @maria: runbook + customer comms draft by Thu

violet: question — anyone object to the Fri 12-16 UTC migration window? :thinking_face:

sam: no objections. confirm we should do 12-16 to include APAC support overlap.

aj: fine with 12-16. will aim to validate cold-start numbers before then.

karen: okay — I'll book the threat-model slot and invite infra/runtime.

maria: will draft comms and post to #customer-success for review.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: canary rollout planned for 2025-07-18T12:00:00Z -> 5% (auto) -> monitor. :rocket:

ben: acked. I'll add the rollback automation hooks to the routing layer and pair w/ @aj for cache cutover steps.

violet: thanks all — I'll update the initiative spec with these gates and post a follow-up doc. If anything major changes, call in the runway sync. :thumbsup:
